title: Flaming Katy - Kalanchoe blossfeldiana - Hardy Succulent Houseplant
description:
Kalanchoe blossfeldiana (Flaming Katy) – Mini Plug Plant
 

 A compact, evergreen succulent perennial with fleshy, glossy leaves and clusters of long-lasting, tubular red flowers in early spring. Reaching 10–40 cm in height and spread, it thrives in bright, filtered light and is ideal for indoor displays, patio pots, or sheltered summer spots.


   Ultimate size:
  
  10–50 cm tall, 10–50 cm spread (2–5 years to maturity)
 

   Habit:
  
  Bushy, evergreen succulent
 

   Position:
  
  Bright, indirect light; prefers partial shade outdoors in summer
 

   Soil:
  
  Free-draining loam or sandy compost, moist but not waterlogged
 

   Care:
  
  Moderate watering during growth, sparingly in dormancy; feed occasionally in season. No pruning required.
 

   Hardiness:
  
  H1b – best grown indoors; can be placed outside in summer (min 10 °C)
 

   Other information:
  
  Drought-tolerant; generally pest- and disease-free, but may be susceptible to mealybugs or vine weevil.
  
   Harmful if eaten by pets.
  

 A versatile, low-maintenance houseplant that adds vibrant colour to windowsills, conservatories, and containers.
